notes: Selected portrait design refinement; prior portrait and landscape files are preserved.
80x80mm body footprint excludes unchanged 12mm front Tab5 thickness; body height80mm. Tab5 remains at47,0,62mm with camera above and face in screen upper half.
Broad planar cheeks, R6 outer perimeter and R10 window corners echo original rounded MicroDuck leg casings. Wall2.4mm; transparent empty windows are true solid cutouts.
PLA density1240kg/m3 is an explicit mass assumption, not a measured printed part. No strength or printer-fit certification.

Rear cover uses provisional M2 clearance holes and captive-nut pockets; actual screw/nut dimensions and print clearance require a fit coupon. Robot and Tab5 mounting interfaces require measurement before drilling or hardware use.
Rounded mounting-post feet stay inside prior solid envelopes and increase corner clearance. Mount fastener allowance4g covers unspecified original-plate attachment hardware.
Tab5 rear mount hole centers derive from official dimension drawing: portraitY±36, Z75 and122mm. M3 screw engagement length is not specified by the drawing and requires measurement.
Original center post feet have no corresponding stock bolt holes. Proposed saddle clamp uses the existing center slot; load capacity and cable access remain unverified.

collision_note: Each connected cell-solid is covered by its convex hull. Small concavities may be filled locally; visual/collider coverage and static CAD interactions require independent audit. No window-spanning single convex hull.
cad_status: Print concept. Watertight solids and nominal assembly geometry, not validated hardware screw interfaces or strength.
